# Pilar Compass

> For Sekolah Pilar Indonesia students — find open academic competitions and estimate a transparent university match %.

## Product
- School: Sekolah Pilar Indonesia (https://sekolah-pilar-indonesia.sch.id/)
- Audience: SPI Junior & Senior High (members only via soft email gate; prototype accepts any email)
- Modules: Competition finder + University match calculator

## Docs
- [PRD](docs/PRD.md)
- [RFC](docs/RFC.md)

## Stack
Next.js 16 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · Netlify

## Run locally
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Test
```bash
npm test
```

## Deploy
Connect this repo to Netlify (see `netlify.toml`). Build command: `npm run build`.

## Honesty notes
- Competition list is curated JSON (not live scrape). Refresh re-filters by today's date.
- Match % is an illustrative heuristic with visible weights — not official admissions odds.
